sentences.en: This TV show tackles issues of teenage pregnancy and homosexuality.
sentences.zh: 这部电视剧探讨了青少年怀孕和同性恋等问题。

sentences.en: In pregnancy, the first three months are the most critical.
sentences.zh: 在怀孕期间，前三个月是最关键的。

sentences.en: Almost half of pregnancies in the United States are unplanned.
sentences.zh: 美国大约有一半的怀孕是意外怀孕。
